title: docs.tracy.ai opens on a home page for people who use Tracy Cowork (Get started, Download the app); the API's front page moved to /api/ and every API page keeps its slug; the sidebar reads Get started · Using Tracy · Desktop app · Changelog · For developers in every language
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd`.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
S3: Run `pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-infra-contracts.ts` and read its last line.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.
fence: The home page is read from src/content/docs/index.mdx (hero links and card links), the API front page from api/index.mdx; the sidebar tree is the one list in sidebar.mjs, and the infra-contracts gate requires every translation's _sidebar.json to carry exactly its label keys and every translated home page to link the same pages inside its own language. No network, no database, no build.

tests: the home page sends a reader to Get started and to the app download
the home page links each part of the site once, the API as one card
the API front page is at /api/ and still opens on the Quickstart
the sidebar reads Get started · Using Tracy · Desktop app · Changelog · For developers
every sidebar label is translated in every _sidebar.json
a translated label reaches the sidebar under its language tag
every page the sidebar names exists in the English tree
